overview: The Shadow-Tainted Lowlands are where corruption becomes ambient and self-sustaining.
history: Shadow-taint seeped outward from the Rift Basin.
Collapsed conduits leaked corruption into the soil.
Akhevan ritual failures created unstable decay zones.
Wildlife mutated into aggressive shadow-tainted forms.
The lowlands became the final barrier before the inner sanctum.
hooks: A sludge pool begins expanding rapidly.
Shadow-tainted creatures swarm a collapsed conduit.
A failed ritual site emits dangerous pulses.
A scout reports the lowlands shifting unnaturally.
